label: Affinity equivocal; embryophytic cryptospores not demonstrated
age_note: Cambrian; no valid Cambrian stage values exist in data/timescale.csv. Hooper does not accept these irregular arrangements as an unequivocal embryophyte calibration. Stage range set to the whole Cambrian (Fortunian–Stage 10) by Claude Opus 5.5 when the Cambrian stages were added to data/timescale.csv.
main_basis: Latest substantive assessment and rejected-records entry 10 agree that embryophyte affinity is unresolved.
support: The Hooper et al. (2026) supplementary information calls the affinity of the Cambrian palynomorphs equivocal because they lack the regular geometric arrangements of younger cryptospores.

label: Cambrian cryptospores used as embryophyte-origin evidence
age_note: Primer reports a 515.5 Ma maximum derived from Cambrian cryptospores. This is a calibration bound, not the measured age of every grouped occurrence. Cambrian stages absent from the repository timescale. Stage range set to the whole Cambrian (Fortunian–Stage 10) by Claude Opus 5.5 when the Cambrian stages were added to data/timescale.csv.
held_by: Morris et al. (2018), as summarised in the primer and Hooper SI
main_basis: Historical inclusive affinity reading retained; later assessment treats the affinity as equivocal.
support: Morris et al. (2018) set the maximum from Cambrian cryptospores (515.5 Ma)

label: Charophyte-grade or intermediate palynomorphs
age_note: Cambrian occurrences; no finer common stage assignment established. Do not encode Cambrian material as Tremadocian merely to fit the current timescale. Stage range set to the whole Cambrian (Fortunian–Stage 10) by Claude Opus 5.5 when the Cambrian stages were added to data/timescale.csv.
held_by: Wellman, Cascales-Miñana and Servais (2022), reviewing Strother and Foster (2021)
main_basis: Published alternative retained; latest Hooper assessment and the project register remain explicitly equivocal.
support: that they represent charophyte algal remains

label: Inclusive historical cryptospore reading
age_note: Tremadocian, reported about 480 Ma. This is the historical inclusive reading summarised by the register, not a claim that Strother and Foster demonstrate unequivocal embryophytes.
held_by: Authors including irregular polyads among land-plant cryptospores, as reviewed by Wellman et al. (2022)
main_basis: Retained as the published inclusive position summarised in entry 10; original proponents are not individually identified there.
support: included with the cryptospores by some authors and so counted as the earliest land-plant spores.

label: Intermediate morphology between algal and embryophyte spores
age_note: Primary abstract gives Tremadocian, about 480 Ma; age is retained independently of affinity.
main_basis: Primary transitional interpretation retained; it does not establish unequivocal E2.
support: whose spores are of intermediate morphology between confirmed land-plant spores and earlier forms of uncertain relationship

label: Algal-grade or intermediate; embryophyte affinity unresolved
age_note: Tremadocian age retained. Exclusion concerns organismal affinity, not misdating.
main_basis: Most recent substantive assessment specifically covering Cambrian–Early Ordovician palynomorphs, consistent with entry 10's adopted unresolved status.
support: algal-grade or intermediate, not shown to be land-plant spores
